newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nanjing Electronic eyes IPO of 40-50 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Nanjing Electronic eyes IPO of 40-50 mln A shares.

text.p: Nanjing Huadong Electronic Group Co Ltd plans to apply for an initial public offering of 40 to 50 million A shares on the Shenzhen bourse, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
The company will make an application to the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) by the end of February, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter.

The CSRC has given Huadong preliminary approval to offer 40 million A shares but the firm wants to issue 50 million, the official said, adding that China Guotai Securities would be the chief underwriter.
The company will use the proceeds to expand its core business of lamps and colour television tube production, he said.
Based in Nanjing, capital of Jiangsu province, the company has a total of 100.76 million shares, made up of 81.16 million shares held by state institutions and 19.60 million staff shares.
The official said the firm estimated its 1996 net profits at about 40 million yuan. He gave no comparative figures.
